framing: Every field is u64be byte length followed by its bytes. Entity and variant tags are fields. UTF-8 is exact; existing identifier prefixes are retained. Index fields are u64be, birth timestamps are i128be Unix nanoseconds. Hash SHA-256 without truncation.
context: Context and body fields below are evidence outside keys; they are not hashed. Unknown fields inside a key are rejected. A body conflict is an immutable-operation conflict, not a prohibition on later revisions.
